identity.execution_source_description: Committed git archive plus benchmark-only worker/affinity metadata and Julia --startup-file=no patch; no dirty production code.

build_configuration.dependency_notes: Copied unchanged existing ignored locks, matching prior offline wheels/vendor; Julia committed Manifest, independent venv/target/depot overlay.

preflight_gate.threshold: Each worker CPU/wall >=0.90; aggregate >=0.90*N; native/BLAS bounded kernels CPU/wall >=1.5 with >=2 threads >0.1s

tensor0_native.kernel: Tensor0 public reduce_sum independent outputs 4096x4096 F64

preflight_gate.scope: Native reduction verified in compiled HLO and per-thread CPU time; TensorMap MERA SU2 smoke; TensorKit large multiplication. Does not assert full occupancy for every suite workload.

monitoring.quota: unlimited at all observed cgroup ancestors

limitations: Shared node and unlocked frequency; cache/memory interference cannot be excluded.
4t/8t same-version sequential descriptive comparison, not randomized scalability trial.
Old cpu-1t uses revision333de65 and cannot be used for same-version scaling.
Process CPU/wall includes startup, compilation and preparation; not timed-kernel occupancy.
Per-thread gate is bounded representative evidence, not proof that every workload uses all cores.
publication_metadata.as_run_provenance: Snapshot intentionally has no .git; original runner identity unknown; publication metadata supplies verified revision.
publication_metadata.path_privacy: Auxiliary home/run paths omitted; native extension repository-relative, compiler prefix placeholder; runner payload and samples unchanged.
